_comment: AIG-10 — server-side guardrail on POST https://api.mistral.ai/v1/chat/completions (also accepted on /v1/conversations for agents). Verified 2026-10-13 on docs.mistral.ai/capabilities/guardrailing. With action=block a violating request or response returns HTTP 403 'Content blocked by guardrail'; block_on_error=true also blocks when the guardrail itself fails (error code 3201). Threshold keys are moderation category names and are model-version dependent; the deprecated boolean `safe_prompt` is NOT used here.
